1. test_regression_issue_217: Expects 'one   two\tthree' -> 'one two\tthree' (preserving tab), but the docstring spec says to collapse ALL whitespace runs into single ASCII spaces.

2. test_pasted_text: Expects zero-width characters (U+200B ZERO WIDTH SPACE, U+200D ZERO WIDTH JOINER) to be stripped entirely, but these are not whitespace characters (str.isspace() returns False). The docstring only mentions whitespace handling.

Per CONTRIBUTING.md and the pattern identified by @eng-65 in TEXTKIT-119, these appear to be un-reviewed regression checks imported from the data-model migration. QA is in release freeze until the cut.

Request: Please clarify whether to:
a) Follow the documented docstring spec (current implementation is correct)
b) Update the docstring spec to match these tests
c) Mark these tests as expected failures until post-cut review
